faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Bharathidasan University for a temporary research project position based in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The notification invites applications for the post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under a CSIR funded project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree such as M.Sc, B.E, B.Tech, B.VSc, B.Pharm, M.E, M.Tech, MBBS, BDS or equivalent with relevant research experience as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 32 years, with age relaxations up to 5 years applicable for SC, ST, OBC, Women, and Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month plus HRA as per the university norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications via email or post is 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their complete bio-data along with documents via email or post to the designated university contact.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial screening of the submitted bio-data followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and application details can be accessed directly through the important links section provided in this recruitment article.
